text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh! I made the board, but I couldn't 
take 1st place...!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The wall of the Japanese Derby really was 
a thick one after all...!
choice_data_list: Still, that was a magnificent run!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I gave it everything I had... That 
feeling, at least, is completely real.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Also, I'll take today's experience to 
heart and train myself even harder!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And then someday, I'll gift you an even, 
even more incredible title than "Derby 
Trainer"!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Now that that's settled, it's back to 
training...!!
